$comment: Known places where the content pack breaks its own schema, or where a
guided-example step contradicts the candle it points at.
EMPTY IS THE GOAL, and as of content pack v0.2.0 it is empty.
The loader refuses to run on ANY validation failure, and
scripts/check-content-charts.mjs fails on any annotation that contradicts its
own text. An entry here converts one specific, reviewed failure into a loud
warning instead, so the build is not blocked by a defect belonging to the
content owner. Every other violation still stops the process.
These are debts, not exemptions. Delete the entry when the content is fixed.
Code must never be changed to accommodate one of these.
Cleared 12 Sep 2026 by content pack v0.2.0, which fixed all five:
- lesson-4-trading-words principle card was 76 words against a 60-word cap
(split into 'Bid, ask, and spread' + 'Orders, long and short', now 31 and 48)
- lesson-6 guided steps 0 and 1 pointed at candles of the wrong direction
(now candles 1 and 3, the boldest bullish and bearish bodies in the window)
- lesson-7 guided step 0 pointed at the largest body while saying 'smallest'
- lesson-7 guided step 1 talked about bullish candles over a bearish one
(now candle 8, which ends the window's longest bullish run)
